name: workstreams
description: Round primitives for issue-tracker work. /workstreams:sweep reads a repository's milestones and issue dependencies. It reports the unblocked set and the tier behind it, maps the files each issue touches, and sequences the issues into streams, stacks, or one pull request. /workstreams:review takes one draft pull request through verified review rounds to done. /workstreams:stream builds one issue, or one stack of them, in one worktree, with a brief and a sized agent per layer. Each layer gets its own draft pull request, reviewed to done before the next layer is written. /workstreams:question turns a sweep report into an approved plan. It explores every open item before it asks anything, then asks one question at a time, each with a recommendation and the argument against it. It records rulings instead, for anything cheap to reverse, and posts the plan comment on every issue in the round once the plan is approved.
